trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Treat the other 54 entries as a route through story progression, optional activities and a final sweep of outstanding requirements. This guide recommends reading the warnings for trophies 37, 44 and 48 before committing to story progress, then preserving an earlier save where the game permits it. Reaching the ending can leave substantial work unfinished, so compare earned trophies with the full list before deciding that only the platinum remains. PlayStation supplies the reward's identity, but our sources do not establish a separate final interaction, location or exact award trigger after the other requirements are cleared. The 80–140 hour range is this guide's untested whole-list planning allowance, including prerequisite progression, rather than a sourced completion time.
